summary_en: Correction notice: NextField (主要株主) tendering 1,149,120 shares to Akatsuki public tender (part of 5,472,000 shares held). Post-settlement (July 1, 2026): NextField holdings fall to 4,322,880 shares (29.19% voting rights), dropping from first-ranked principal shareholder to second-ranked major shareholder.
title_en: Correction Notice: Partial Revision to 'Notice Regarding Results of Public Tender Offer for Shares of the Company by Akatsuki Corporation in Connection with Business Integration and Changes in Parent Company and Principal Shareholder Status'
translation_en_brief:
This is a correction notice (訂正) to the original announcement of Akatsuki Corporation's public tender offer for Sunny Side Up Group shares in connection with business integration (経営統合). The correction removes the designation "and related company" (その他の関係会社及び) from NextField's pre-transaction attribute classification.

NextField, a major shareholder and principal shareholder (筆頭株主), holds 5,472,000 shares of the company. Of these, NextField is tendering 1,149,120 shares in the Akatsuki public tender offer. Upon settlement on July 1, 2026, NextField's shareholding will decline to 4,322,880 shares, representing 29.19% of voting rights. This reduction causes NextField to lose its status as principal shareholder (筆頭株主) and drop from first-ranked major shareholder to second-ranked major shareholder (第2位大株主).

The correction clarifies NextField's corporate classification: pre-transaction NextField is a major shareholder and principal shareholder (主要株主である筆頭株主); post-transaction NextField becomes a major shareholder (主要株主) only.
